🚨🇮🇷🇺🇸 Iran just set a trap with one oil tanker: stop the "Line Breaker" and risk the Gulf's oil... or let it pass and watch the blockade crack

If the tracking data is right, an Iranian supertanker is heading straight for the US blockade line.

Open-source analysts estimate it reaches the Gulf of Oman in about 11 hours and the blockade line in about 22.

It's a strategically clever move.

Guard-linked media already promised strikes on Saudi, Emirati and Qatari oil if America interferes with the ship.

So stopping it could set the Gulf on fire and restart the war.

Letting it sail means the blockade Trump calls total control has a leaky hole in it, and every idle Iranian tanker follows.

The U.S. is stuck in a catch-22, and the countdown runs until the ship reaches the line.

What would you order?

Source: @officialrnintel, Al Jazeera / Writer: Daniel
